```{r tab-enrich-slim}
#| echo: false
ora <- RD("results", "enrichment", "ora_go.tsv")
slim <- ora[grepl("GOslim", ora$comparison), c("comparison", "Description", "GeneRatio", "pvalue", "p.adjust", "Count")]
slim <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(slim, slim$comparison), function(d) head(d[order(d$p.adjust), ], 8)))
rownames(slim) <- NULL
tbl(slim, digits = 3)
```

```{r fig-goslim}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "GO slim over-representation analysis (top 10 terms per gene set; BH-adjusted p)."
#| out-width: "100%"
include_graphics(FIG("enrichment/go_slim_ora.png"))
```

```{r tab-kegg}
#| echo: false
k <- RD("results", "enrichment", "kegg.tsv")
k <- head(k[order(k$p.adjust), c("ID", "Description", "GeneRatio", "pvalue", "p.adjust", "Count")], 10)
rownames(k) <- NULL
tbl(k, digits = 3)
```

```{r tab-gsea}
#| echo: false
g <- RD("results", "enrichment", "gsea_go.tsv")
g <- g[order(g$p.adjust), c("ID", "Description", "setSize", "NES", "pvalue", "p.adjust")]
g$Description <- substr(g$Description, 1, 60)
g <- head(g, 10)
rownames(g) <- NULL
tbl(g, digits = 3)
```
